selected.text: 🧹 **F-STO-1 (attended 2026-10-25; the owner: "Can you help clean up the storage needed by Gold Rush … I think Gold Rush uses 600 GB") — THE DISK HELD 1,312 GB OF GOLD RUSH, 86 GB FREE OF 3.6 TB; EVERY SCRATCH WORKTREE CARRIES THE 9–11 GB TRACKED `artifacts/` TREE, SO CHECKOUTS WERE THE MULTIPLIER. Group A (regenerable scratch, no history) removed on the owner's "clean A": 30 merged sibling worktrees `~/Claude/Projects/wt-*` (~300 GB), 21 fire/attended arena checkouts under `~/.goldrush/` (their logs kept), the `land/wt-preview-pub` rsync staging copy (86 GB), four re-land clones in `~/.goldrush/repair` whose tips equal the `candidate/*` branches on GitHub (53 GB; commit maps kept), two old gate worktrees in the primary, eight orphan lane copies inside the history clone whose `.git` files pointed at the primary's live lanes (their 94 untracked unique files, 354 MB of July marketing reels and raw media, archived first to `~/.goldrush/archive/history-local-worktrees-untracked-2026-10-25/`), the stray `Gold%20Rush` folder. Every removal through `git worktree remove` after a merged-branch check and an evidence-only dirt check; 14 items the checks held back were examined by hand (stale checkouts: files equal to blobs of 2026-09-20 / 2026-07-05 commits; a gate worktree whose edits equal main's; control arenas differing only in the pilots symlink) and removed in a second pass. Result: free 86 GB → 782 GB. KEPT AS HISTORY: the history clone's `.git` (106 GB, the only full copy of the private history archive: 443 of its 613 refs are not on GitHub), the film's 23 takes (24 GB), `GoldRush-assets` (13 GB), the primary's `artifacts/`, `logs/`, `tasks/runs` (17 GB), `gr-worktree-evidence`, the run logs. OPEN FOR THE OWNER: `gr-gauntlet` (290 GB: four rider arenas with 19 GB duplicate `.git` copies, ~9 GB dependencies, ~100 GB tracked checkouts, ~40 GB heat evidence to keep), `goldrush-gauntlet` carries 22 unpushed commits (agent memories of heats 11–12), an external drive for the ~200 GB of history, and the structural cure (sparse checkouts without `artifacts/` for scratch worktrees). Log: `~/.goldrush/maintenance/cleanup-2026-10-25.log`.

🔎 **F-CUT-1 (attended 2026-10-09, measured during the Option B cutover) — A STATUS-ONLY EDGE PROBE READS A DEAD API AS HEALTHY.** When the daily Workers/Pages Functions cap is exhausted, Pages serves the SPA's `index.html` with HTTP 200 for `/api/stats`; `scripts/health-watch.sh` and `ops/droplet/edge-watch.sh` reported `api=200` for hours while the county's API was dark, and only the route verifier's JSON demand caught it. Corrective `api-probe-json-1` authored and queued (lane-c). **s3000 verification 08:33Z:** stats returns 200 HTML at the canonical and direct Pages URLs; sampled week-41/week-42 standings reads return valid 200 JSON, so the observed failure is specific to stats and is not evidence that every county endpoint is down. The corrective finished during closing; attended fixture cure `782f9c548` and `apj1` landing process 95225 own its remaining gates. `artifacts/s3000/live-probe.json`, `api-custody.json`.

🔺 **F-2642-3 — OWNER: the registry deploy day is now ACTIONABLE, and the desk entry's own trigger condition has been met.** `docs/OWNER-DESK-2026-09-19.md:100–101` reads *"Astra is landing the registry code behind a closed gate now (lane-b) … I bring you the checklist when the code lands."* **The code has landed (`fdfcab4d0`) and the checklist is `docs/ops/account-registry.md`** — five steps, each with its verification and its rollback sentence. ⚖️ **NOTHING DEPLOYED AND NOTHING MIGRATED, by construction and not by promise: the Pages binding ships as a COMMENTED block in `wrangler.toml` with `ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_SCOPE` deliberately unset, so both are absent and the door behaves byte-identically to main — which `closed-gate.test.mjs` asserts directly rather than by inspection.** Routine Pages deploys are unaffected. ⛔ **NO FIRE MAY ENABLE THIS**: the five steps need the owner's own deployment inventory, a quiesce of every identity writer including previews, an independently verified private export, a migration secret and a post-bootstrap smoke test of legacy saves — none of which the repo can know or automate. It is on the desk, not on the board.

📱 **`b1-device-verdict-rows` (B1) — OWNER: ten minutes on your phone, and the device verdict rows are yours to fill.** The 2026-09-19 ruling decided 28 items and left exactly two things with you; this is the first. It is not a design question and nothing is blocked behind it — it wants the device in your pocket, not a decision. **Declared s2644** because the desk carried it unkeyed, which made `desk-carryforward-guard` unable to carry-check it and made the live desk count disagree with what the parser could read (5 declared vs 3 keyable). Keyed now as a backticked slug so it can be tracked across handoffs like any other item.

🔺 **F-2299-1 — OWNER'S DESK (2026-09-24, from the rotation check after the owner's "Ok, I updaed all the keys"): the rotation's last mile: two new values into `.env.local`, and the Claude Code token still the exposed one.** VERIFIED 2026-09-24 read-only, no value printed or copied: the edge API token in `.env.local` is DEAD at its provider (the token-verify endpoint answers `1000 Invalid API Token`) and the voice key is DEAD (`HTTP 401` on the user endpoint), so both rotations happened at the providers; but `.env.local` was last written 2026-09-20, so the file `scripts/deploy.sh` sources still holds the dead values and **every deploy aborts at the wrangler auth until the owner pastes the new `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=` and `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=` lines** (a failed deploy in a fire log until then is THIS, not a regression; do not file it). The fires' own credential, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (the "coding-agent subscription token" of ruling 1), still authenticates through the fires' exact path (`claude auth status` under `~/.claude-fires` reads loggedIn; a one-word `-p` probe answered), so the value exposed on 2026-08-25 is STILL LIVE: the owner mints a new one (`claude setup-token`), pastes it as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=`, and revokes the old one in his account; the attended session re-probes and closes. The droplet holds no stray copy (`find / -name .env.local` empty, `/opt/goldrush/.env.local` absent, read-only over the deploy's own ssh path). The Codex login was refreshed today (`~/.codex/auth.json`, "Logged in using ChatGPT"). Retires when: both new values answer live to the same read-only calls, the Claude probe passes on a NEW value (`.env.local` rewritten) and the owner says the old one is revoked. The original finding is the F-2299-1 row of s2299 below. ➡️ **UPDATE 2026-09-24 18:15 local (owner: "I rotated all tokens in the .env.local file", "I rolled it again"):** the owner rotated all three at the providers and minted a new Claude Code token, but pasted twice into the sibling folder's copy (`Gold Rush-history-local/.env.local`, the pre-rewrite local history), which nothing reads; the attended session found it by mtime, verified its values read-only (Cloudflare `active`, ElevenLabs `200`, the new Claude token answers through the fires' path, per-line hashes: the three rotated lines DIFFERENT, the account id, the router key and the droplet host identical), backed the old root file up outside every git tree (`~/.goldrush/env.local.bak-2026-09-24`, mode 600; a `.bak` beside `.env.local` would NOT be gitignored) and copied the edited file into the repo root; re-verified from the root: Cloudflare `active`, ElevenLabs `200`, Claude `ok`, `wrangler whoami` logged in. DEPLOYS UNBLOCKED. STILL OPEN: the Claude Code token exposed on 2026-08-25 still authenticated at 18:14 when probed from the old file, so it is not revoked; the desk item narrows to that one revocation (the owner's account settings), verified afterwards by the same probe against the backup. ➡️ **UPDATE 2026-09-24 23:2x local (owner, verbatim: "I used the log out of all devices button in the web ui. Then I logged in again, logged in here, then did claude setup-token, copied it in .env.local and then told you done."):** MEASURED, not inferred: after that button, the August token (from the backup) and the 18:13 token (minted before the button) BOTH still answer through the fires' auth path; the button ends browser and CLI sessions (this CLI needed `/login`) but does not revoke long-lived `claude setup-token` tokens. The CLI cannot revoke either (`claude auth logout` clears local credentials only; the only revoke code in the binary is a bundled Google OAuth library; the account endpoints refuse the token with `permission_error`, so its e-mail cannot be read from the token; every login recorded on this Mac is `robin@brainstem.health`, and the fires' config dir dates from 2026-07-08, so the token was minted on or before that day). The newest token (23:16) had again gone to the sibling folder's file; copied into the repo root with the 18:15 root kept at `~/.goldrush/env.local.bak-2026-09-24-1815` (mode 600); root re-verified: Claude ok, Cloudflare active, ElevenLabs 200. REMAINING, owner-side: an Anthropic support request to revoke the Claude Code token minted on or before 2026-07-08 for `robin@brainstem.health` (the exposed one; the 2026-09-24 tokens stay), or its natural expiry; the attended session re-probes from the backup and closes the row when it fails. Exposure bound meanwhile: inference on the owner's subscription only (the account endpoints refuse it). ➡️ **SUPPORT REQUEST ISSUED (owner 2026-09-25, verbatim: "support request is issued"):** the revocation of the August Claude Code token is with Anthropic support; the attended session re-probes the backup token each session (`claude -p ok` under the fires' config from `~/.goldrush/env.local.bak-2026-09-24`) and closes this row, retires the desk item and removes both backup files (owner's word; `rm` prompts) on the first refusal. Until then: live, inference scope only. RULED 2026-09-26 (verbatim "D - as you recommend it"): the attended session keeps re-probing the backup token and retires this row, removing both backup files, on the first refusal.
